cues.en: Let's talk about Hadoop.
cues.zh: 來談 Hadoop。

cues.en: So as companies started to generate more and more data, our databases that we had, like MySQL, became
cues.zh: 公司產生的資料越來越多，MySQL 等原本的資料庫變得，

cues.en: too inefficient or unable to hold the large amounts of data.
cues.zh: 效率不足，或無法容納大量資料。

cues.en: And Hadoop became a cornerstone of data engineering.
cues.zh: Hadoop 因而成為資料工程的重要基石。

cues.en: You see, Hadoop is an open source distributed processing framework.
cues.zh: Hadoop 是開放原始碼的分散式處理框架。

cues.en: It allows us to do data processing and storage for big data.
cues.zh: 讓我們對大數據進行處理與儲存。

cues.en: And it was actually developed by Yahoo!
cues.zh: 它早期由 Yahoo!，

cues.en: Back in the day and then later donated to the Apache Software Foundation.
cues.zh: 開發，後來捐贈給 Apache Software Foundation。

cues.en: Hadoop was all the rage when the big data craze started.
cues.zh: 大數據熱潮剛開始時，Hadoop 非常熱門。

cues.en: Hadoop was a solution that allowed all these companies with petabytes of data to store this information in Hadoop.
cues.zh: 讓擁有 PB 等級資料的公司，能把資訊存進 Hadoop。

cues.en: Now, Hadoop was essentially a data lake, right?
cues.zh: Hadoop 基本上是一種資料湖，對吧？

cues.en: It's a data lake solution.
cues.zh: 是一種資料湖解決方案。

cues.en: It allows us to just store all this data for us.
cues.zh: 能儲存所有這些資料。

cues.en: But the popularity of Hadoop was because of two big things.
cues.zh: 它受到歡迎，主要有兩個原因。

cues.en: One was HD FS.
cues.zh: 第一是 HDFS。

cues.en: That is the Hadoop distributed file system.
cues.zh: 也就是 Hadoop Distributed File System，Hadoop 分散式檔案系統。

cues.en: Hadoop was able to store so much data because of this HDFS, a file system just like you have on your computer that allowed it to store files on multiple computers.
cues.zh: Hadoop 能儲存這麼多資料，就是因為 HDFS。它像電腦上的檔案系統，但能跨多台電腦存檔。

cues.en: That is, we can use Hadoop on multiple computers to store as much data as we want.
cues.zh: 也就是在多台電腦使用 Hadoop，儲存所需的大量資料。

cues.en: It was scalable.
cues.zh: 它能擴充。

cues.en: We could scale out.
cues.zh: 可以水平擴充。

cues.en: So data is stored across different physical computers.
cues.zh: 資料分散儲存在不同的實體電腦。

cues.en: Then was MapReduce, because once we store data, we need to perform some jobs, some processing on that data.
cues.zh: 接著是 MapReduce，因為存好資料後，還得執行工作、處理資料，

cues.en: Right.
cues.zh: 對吧。

cues.en: And MapReduce in Hadoop allowed us to perform jobs against this data that we had in a data lake using
cues.zh: Hadoop 的 MapReduce 讓我們對資料湖裡的資料執行工作，使用，

cues.en: languages like Java or Python.
cues.zh: Java、Python 等語言。

cues.en: You can use MapReduce in Hadoop to do what we call batch processing.
cues.zh: 透過 Hadoop 的 MapReduce，可以進行批次處理。

cues.en: That is, every night we can run some sort of a job to clean our data, to process our data and make it useful for the company.
cues.zh: 例如每天晚上執行某個工作，清理、處理資料，轉成對公司有用的形式。

cues.en: Now, MapReduce isn't used as often anymore as we'll see later on in the videos because we have something called Apache Spark that's actually a little bit faster.
cues.zh: 錄製時，MapReduce 已不像以前那麼常用，後面會看到，因為有速度更快一些的 Apache Spark。

cues.en: But we'll get to that.
cues.zh: 不過稍後再談。

cues.en: The idea here is that we finally had a tool with Hadoop that allows us to store a lot of data across
cues.zh: 重點是，Hadoop 終於提供一套工具，透過 HDFS，在，

cues.en: multiple machines using the HDFS and Ron batch jobs using MapReduce on this large sets of data and a
cues.zh: 多台機器儲存大量資料，再使用 MapReduce 對大型資料集執行批次工作。也有，

cues.en: lot of other tools started popping up around Hadoop tools such as Hive.
cues.zh: 許多其他工具圍繞 Hadoop 出現，例如 Hive。

cues.en: Love their logo, by the way.
cues.zh: 順帶一提，我很喜歡它的標誌。

cues.en: Check that out.
cues.zh: 你看。

cues.en: Anyway.
cues.zh: 總之。

cues.en: Hive makes your Hadoop cluster.
cues.zh: Hive 讓 Hadoop 叢集，

cues.en: Feel like it's a relational database.
cues.zh: 用起來像關聯式資料庫。

cues.en: Even though it isn't.
cues.zh: 即使它本身不是。

cues.en: It allows you to use Hive and write SQL queries against your HDFS file system.
cues.zh: 可以用 Hive，對 HDFS 檔案系統撰寫 SQL 查詢。

cues.en: So in a sense, you kind of had this data lake of Hadoop and also a little bit of a data warehouse type
cues.zh: 所以某種程度上，有 Hadoop 資料湖，也透過 Hive，得到一點資料倉儲，

cues.en: thing with Hive by allowing SQL commands on your data that hopefully was processed using MapReduce.
cues.zh: 的感覺，對已用 MapReduce 處理好的資料執行 SQL 指令。

cues.en: And you may not have heard of Hadoop before because it's used by data engineers.
cues.zh: 你可能沒聽過 Hadoop，因為主要是資料工程師在使用。

cues.en: Remember, data engineers usually don't work on systems that are customer facing.
cues.zh: 記得，資料工程師通常不建立直接面對客戶的系統。

cues.en: That is, they don't build databases that you would use with your app or with a web app.
cues.zh: 也就是通常不建立應用程式或網路應用直接使用的資料庫。

cues.en: Instead, they build the systems behind the scenes that ingests, collects, runs, ETL, jobs, that is extract, transform, load on data.
cues.zh: 而是建立幕後的系統，擷取、收集資料，執行 ETL，也就是擷取、轉換、載入。

cues.en: So Hadoop, is that behind the scenes storage layer that stores large amount of data running batch processing
cues.zh: 因此 Hadoop 是幕後的儲存層，保存大量資料，對資料執行批次，

cues.en: against this data so that we can have some useful information.
cues.zh: 處理，讓我們取得有用資訊。

cues.en: And Hadoop is still very popular and very capable when it comes to large data, petabytes of data.
cues.zh: 在錄製時，面對 PB 等級的大量資料，Hadoop 仍很受歡迎，也很有能力。

cues.en: Let's learn a few more tools in the next video.
cues.zh: 下一支影片再認識幾個工具。
